about: The hand-kept decisions of the spell data (design 3.1): what the client rows and the measured values leave to judgement. Each entry has its reason (why) and its source. tools/dev/make_spelltips.py applies them over coef.json, threat.json, gear.json and client_spells.json, and refuses an entry that names a key, a spell or a part it does not know.

downrank.why: Blizzard's client text says spell ranks far below the caster's level benefit less from spell damage and healing (STAT_SPELLPOWER_TOOLTIP, STAT_SPELLHEALING_TOOLTIP) but gives no formula. ForeverChanges measured heals on beta build 1.60.1.70338 up to level 30: a rank keeps its full bonus for 17 levels after it is learned and loses 5% a level from the 18th. Ozgar's calculator uses 16 levels; a summary of Blizzard's notes of November 2 says the penalty was removed at launch. Its size is not known, so the factor is an estimate with a row to turn it off.
source: client text STAT_SPELLPOWER_TOOLTIP and STAT_SPELLHEALING_TOOLTIP (GlobalStrings, build 1.60.1.70938)
Blizzard, WoW: Forever development notes of 2026-10-01 and 2026-11-02 (read through search summaries)

spells.why: No line: Dark Pact is Classic only, and Drain Mana, Lay on Hands and Bloom's Spirit heal take no spell power and have no threat known on Forever. Rockbiter Weapon, Windfury Totem and Seal of the Crusader give attack power, which the character sheet already counts (Rockbiter Weapon's enchants stay in rockbiter for Spirit Weapons' threat); Flametongue Totem's hits (16368) and Judgement of the Crusader's Holy damage taken have no coefficient of their own; Swiftmend heals for the HoT it reads, with no share of its own; Deep Wounds takes no attack power on Forever (measured) and Kidney Shot deals no damage. None of them is in the slices; the keys stand here so a later slice cannot bring them back unnoticed.
source: wowsims/forever docs/evidence/EV-0013 (Flametongue Totem's hit 16368 has no coefficient)
wowsims/forever docs/evidence/EV-0139 (Deep Wounds takes no attack power)

threat.why: Their threat on Forever is not known (no reading, no rule in the client data), so they get no threat line: Power Word: Shield's absorb, Execute, Whirlwind. The blessings, Battle Shout, Disarm and Holy Shield's cast threat are not in the threat slice for the same reason.
source: client rows of build 1.60.1.70938 (no THREAT effect)

seal of righteousness.why: Its text counts Holy spell damage through variables 1023 ($1h = 0.0765 x $SPH, $2h = 0.12 x $SPH) and shows a range from a fast one-hander to a slow two-hander, not the player's own hit, while 10% was measured with one-handers at every speed from 1.8 to 3.8 and 12% with two-handers. So the line gives the measured share and the amount alone.

revenge.why: Its text counts attack power through variables 1024: $APR = 0.225 in Defensive Stance (aura 71), else 0.25. The 0.25 was measured on rank 4 (0.2518), and Defensive Stance's 10% less damage (7376 effect 1) makes the 0.225.

seal of righteousness.note: the game's text counts 7.65% for one-handers
seal of righteousness.why: The second half of the dim line under the share of design 1.3. SpellModel.lua words that line itself: "The game's text shows a range for any weapon", then "and" and this note with a one-hander, the first half alone with a two-hander.

judgement of command.note: half unless the target is stunned
judgement of command.why: Its seal's text deals half the judgement's damage unless the target is stunned or incapacitated ($/2;20966s1). The comparison works against a boss or an enemy of your level, neither of them stunned, so it counts half (free) of the whole part, an estimate: the simulator halves only the base, the research the spell damage share too.

consecration.why: Only the first 4 enemies who enter the area take the part with spell power (the text's $s3 = 4); every other enemy takes the flat tick of part 1, which has none.

hellfire.why: The second part burns the caster, not enemies: it is damage to the warlock and never counted as damage dealt.
source: client rows 1949, 11683, 11684 effect 1 (periodic damage on the caster)

demonic brand.note: the larger of your Shadow and Fire spell damage, on the pet's next attacks
demonic brand.why: Variables 1016 take the larger of $SPS and $SPFI, and the damage comes with the pet's attacks.

whirlwind.note: off hand at half, as the simulator models it
whirlwind.why: The text says both weapons; the off-hand half is the simulator's, not measured.

mutilate.note: whether the off hand is halved is not known
mutilate.why: No reading covers the off-hand strike of Mutilate.

ghostly strike.why: Its text deals $s1% weapon damage, $m4% if a dagger is in the main hand: effect 3 holds the dagger's percent (180).
source: client row 14278 effects 0 and 3, and its text

hemorrhage.why: Its text deals $m4% weapon damage, $m5% if a dagger is equipped: effect 4 holds the dagger's percent (145).
source: client row 16511 effects 3 and 4, and its text

penance.why: The rank rows hold no duration and their bolts are not periodic; every rank's text names the channel's helper row ($402261t2, $402261d), which lasts 2000 ms with a bolt a second, so 3 bolts land in 2 seconds.

power word: shield.why: Its absorb row stores 0.1 but no row or text says whether healing or spell damage counts; healing is the vanilla rule, an estimate (design 3.5).

rupture.why: No row holds Rupture's attack power shares: its rows give points a combo point and no attack power coefficient. The shares are the 1.12 table the simulator keeps, unverified on Forever (design 3.6).
source: wowsims/forever simulator (its Rupture table, the 1.12 rule)
client rows 1943 to 11275 (no attack power coefficient)

frostfire bolt.why: Its school is Fire and Frost (mask 20); the client does not say which spell damage counts, so the lower of the two is taken, an estimate.

windfury weapon.why: Its two extra attacks are swings of the main-hand weapon, Physical, while the imbue spell's own school is Nature.

demonic brand.why: The talent's row has the Physical school; the share is of spell damage, the larger of Shadow and Fire (variables 1016), and Shadow is its tree's school. Its text counts it, so only the share shows.

levels.why: These spells have no level row in either client input. Attack is every character's from level 1. The talents are at the top level: the downranking estimate is about casting a low rank of a spell, and a talent's one rank is never a low rank, so the top level keeps the estimate's factor at 1. No part of these spells has a gain a level that the level would start.
source: client rows of build 1.60.1.70938 and 1.60.1.70888 (no SpellLevels row for 6603, 14278, 14251, 1293695)

seal of righteousness.why: The seal's hit on each swing is a melee special that cannot miss and can crit; the rank row itself is a self buff of the magic line.

defensive.note: Defiance counts only with a shield
defensive.why: Defensive Stance's text gives the total with Defiance ($?a12792[...]) but not that Defiance needs a shield, which Defiance's own text says.

battle.why: Battle Stance's text says nothing of threat, so its tooltip shows the multiplier.

berserker.why: Berserker Stance's text says nothing of threat, so its tooltip shows the multiplier.

bear.why: The bear forms' texts say nothing of threat, so their tooltips show the multiplier.

cat.why: Cat Form's text says nothing of threat, so its tooltip shows the multiplier.

fury.why: Its text gives 33% for all threat and 90% more for Holy; threat auras multiply, so Holy is about x2.53, not measured.

silentresolve.why: Its text says the threat of your spells; on Forever its aura counts Holy and Shadow only (school mask 34).

threat_items.why: The worn items whose Equip effect changes all threat on Forever (a MOD_THREAT aura of school mask 127 on their equip spell), and the two threat enchants of gloves and cloak. The multiplier comes from the equip spell's row. Items the client holds with no item record, and items whose threat comes from a use effect or a proc, are not worn effects and are left out.
source: client rows of the equip spells (build 1.60.1.70938)
client items and enchants of build 1.60.1.70888 (GrunzForever export: ItemSparse, ItemEffect, SpellItemEnchantment)

nb.why: Since the hotfix of 2026-11-11 the judgements are ranged attacks that cannot be blocked, but Judgement of Command, a melee attack again since 2026-11-16.
source: Blizzard, WoW: Forever hotfixes of 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-16 (read through search summaries)

nm.why: Its text says it cannot miss.

compare.why: kinds: Holy Shock, Penance and Holy Nova heal or harm by their target and count as the heal they are in a healer's lines (Penance a channelled heal, so its second is one of the channel); Seal of Righteousness and Seal of Command are worked out from the swings (design 2.5), Holy Shield a proc on each block, Sunder Armor and Faerie Fire count their threat. none: procs, totems, traps, poisons and imbues whose rate the model does not know, the finishers whose base grows with combo points in ways the rows do not give (Rupture's duration, Death Mark's stored damage), and spells whose amount is not the spell's own (Mana Burn and Feedback burn mana, Health Funnel heals the pet, Lightwell Renew is cast by the Lightwell, Execute converts rage, Inferno summons, Contingency Plan and Prayer of Mending wait for damage). They keep their tooltip lines.

defaults.why: The default lines of design 2.1 by class and by the role ns.PlayerRole gives (damage, tank, healer), and a druid's cat set (cat) for Cat Form; a bear form takes the tank set. Every line counts only if known. A line is a key; a list of keys is the first of them known (Greater Heal, else Heal, else Lesser Heal, so a priest has a heal from level 1); an object { needs, keys, else } is each of its keys while needs is known, else each of else (the seal and judgement of Command with Seal of Command known, else those of Righteousness; a shaman's Attack and Stormstrike with Stormstrike known). make_spelltips.py writes the object as { key, key ..., needs = key, ["else"] = { key ... } }, which GearLines.lua reads.

retribution aura.why: A server rule: the rows store 0, and Retribution Aura deals 6% of the paladin's spell damage a hit on Forever, as Blizzard's tuning of 2026-10-08 says and readings show.
source: Blizzard, WoW: Forever beta tuning of 2026-10-08 (read through search summaries)

source: Blizzard, WoW: Forever beta tuning of 2026-10-08 (read through search summaries)

seal of righteousness.why: A server rule: 10% of Holy spell damage a hit with a one-hander (12% with a two-hander), measured at every weapon speed; rank 8's row stores 0 and counts as rank 7.

seal of command.why: The proc row stores 0.29 on its weapon-percent effect, and the 70% applies to it: 0.29 x 0.70 = 0.203 of Holy spell damage a proc, measured as 20.4%.

holy strike.why: The row stores 0.429 on the normalized weapon effect, and the rank's weapon percent applies to it (0.429 x 25% to 50%), as the simulator models it; not measured.

ice lance.why: The rows store 0 (the server adds it); 0.10 is a community fit of beta combat logs (rank 1 about 0.095, rank 2 about 0.113), an estimate.

ice barrier.why: The absorb effect stores 0; the client's own text adds 10% of Frost spell damage ($SPFR*0.1). Whether the server adds it is not tested.
source: client text of Ice Barrier (hotfix push 112753)

frost ward.why: The absorb effect stores 0; the client's own text adds 10% of Frost spell damage ($SPFR*0.1). Whether the server adds it is not tested.
source: client text of Frost Ward (hotfix push 113024)

rockbiter.why: Spirit Weapons raises threat with Rockbiter Weapon on the main hand (x1.302 in all). The imbue is a temporary enchant of the weapon, so SpellModel reads the main hand's enchant and holds it against the enchants of these seven ranks, each the misc value of the rank's enchant effect (360).
source: client rows of the seven ranks of Rockbiter Weapon (effect 360)

seal of righteousness.why: The per-hit base of Seal of Righteousness is value / 100 x weapon speed x hand factor, with value the dummy effect of the judgement of the same rank; the seal's own dummy aura holds the same number.

judgements.about: A judgement's damage rank is a row of its own that no spell book holds: the game casts it from the seal that is up, at the seal's rank. Each judgement names its seal (the entry field seal), and SpellModel.lua's M.Highest gives the judgement the rank of the same place as the highest rank of its seal the player knows. Each pair has as many ranks.

judgement of command.why: Seal of Command's judgement deals the damage of 20467 to 20966, one rank a seal rank.
source: client rows 20375 to 20920 (the seal) and 20467 to 20966 (its judgement)

source: client rows of Seal of Fury and Judgement of Fury, build 1.60.1.70938
